subject: Post-call: interop scorecard + POC test plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Park <kelsey@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: interop scorecard + POC test plan

Hi Kelsey — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + evidence retrieval (latency-sensitive for live agent UI).
- Current constraints: must be OpenAI-compatible API (ease of SDK swap), strict PII controls, and annual contract with initial throughput of ~150 concurrent users.
- Procurement questions flagged: SOC2 evidence, data residency options, and contract SLAs.

Differentiators we covered (brief):
- OpenAI-compatible endpoint + request/response parity for prompt/response shapes
- Dedicated pools for predictable latency and isolation (Dedicated product)
- Batching and KV caching to reduce per-token costs without harming 99th pctl latency

Proposed POC / tests (high level):
1) API parity smoke: swap a small integration to our OpenAI-compatible endpoint and verify prompts + tool calls.
2) Latency matrix: 95th/99th pctl across typical prompt lengths (short chat vs long context retrieval).
3) Cost delta: token throughput comparison with your current hyperscaler endpoint for same prompt set.
4) Edge cases: streaming behavior, function/tool callbacks, and stop-sequence differences.

I've attached an initial interop scorecard (redwood_interop_scorecard_draft.xlsx) and our migration playbook. Can you confirm 2 things so we lock the test plan?
- Who on your side should we share the sample prompts with (email or S3 link)?
- Any hard non-negotiable latency targets (95th / 99th) we should measure to?

Next steps / timeline proposal:
- This week: we send the scorecard + test harness and ask for prompt set (target: Tue).
- Next week: run baseline tests vs your current endpoint; we’ll share initial comparisons within 3 business days of receiving prompts.

If that sounds good I’ll CC engineering and get the test harness ready.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: redwood_interop_scorecard_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_migration_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: Post-call: interop scorecard + POC test plan

Ben — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Prompt set: I'll put together an anonymized sample set (agent conversation snippets + retrieval prompts). Please send an S3 upload link; I can't attach raw data over email.
2) Latency targets: our bar for the agent UI is 95th < 350ms and 99th < 700ms for short prompts (<= 256 tokens). For long-context retrieval flows we expect 95th < 600ms. Those are hard targets for the pilot.
3) Hyperscaler comparison: we currently run against HyperscalerX managed endpoint (gX-infer) — key asks from our side are a direct apples-to-apples comparison for average token cost and 99th latencies.
4) Procurement: procurement@acmeanalytics.com will want SOC2 Type II evidence, our vendor risk assessment, and estimated monthly spend for pilot vs production.

Also looping in James who will own engineering validation — James, Ben will share the test harness and scorecard.

Kelsey Park
Head of Platform Integrations | Acme Analytics
kelsey@acmeanalytics.com

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Kelsey's notes. Draft test matrix below (I attached an editable XLS in my notes and will dump into the shared Drive folder):

Proposed test matrix (high level):
- Test A: API parity smoke (2 hours) — verify request/response schema for 20 canonical prompts; pass/fail if any incompatible field or function-calling mismatch. Owner: Marissa.
- Test B: Short prompt latency (4 runs x 30 mins) — 95th and 99th measured vs HyperscalerX baseline. Owner: Karthik.
- Test C: Long-context retrieval (3 runs x 1 hour) — KV cache behavior and tail latency. Owner: Karthik.
- Test D: Token cost delta (single-run synthetic) — measure tokens consumed for canonical prompts and compute cost at current pricing and Redwood hosted pricing. Owner: Finance + Marissa to estimate.
- Test E: Streaming & function-calls (manual validation) — developer UX parity for streaming chunks and tool-calling payloads. Owner: Marissa.

Dependencies:
- Need sample prompts + anonymized traces from Acme (S3 preferred).
- Need HyperscalerX credentials / endpoint to run direct baseline tests (or we can ask Acme to share representative logs for reproduction).

Timeline (aggressive):
- Tue (10/13): receive prompt set + credentials or logs
- Wed–Thu: run smoke + short latency runs
- Fri: deliver initial scorecard and cost delta analysis

I'll prepare the XLS (interop test matrix) and a minimal harness (Docker image + scripts) that James can run locally if they prefer.

Marissa

POC plan (confirmed):
- Deliverables: interop_scorecard (completed after runs), test harness (Docker + scripts), and a short migration playbook with checklist for SDK swap.
- Timeline: we expect to deliver initial results by Fri 10/16 if we receive prompts and either HyperscalerX endpoint or logs by EOD Tue 10/13.
- Owners: Marissa (harness + interop scoring), Karthik (latency/cost runs), Ben (project lead / procurement coordination).

Procurement asks (for your team):
- Please share the vendor questionnaire PDF (or point us to your procurement portal). We will attach SOC2 Type II and our standard MSA.
- Estimate: to size the pilot (4 weeks, expected 150 concurrent users peak), we'll prepare a cost estimate and invite you to a short pricing call.

Hyperscaler comparison items we will return:
- 95th and 99th latency numbers for short and long contexts (same prompt set)
- Per-token cost normalized to your current plan (we'll show raw token counts and compute cost under both pricing models)
- Short note on behavioral diffs (streaming chunk sizes, function-calls, stop-sequence handling) with examples from the prompt set.

Action items for Acme (Kelsey / James):
- Upload anonymized prompt set to the shared S3 folder and grant read access to redwood-poc@redwood.ai (we'll send a presigned upload link if you prefer).
- Share HyperscalerX endpoint / creds OR export 48h request logs for reproduction.
- Procurement: email the vendor questionnaire to procurement@redwood.ai and procurement@acmeanalytics.com in parallel (we'll turn around SOC2 + MSA).

Links: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2026-PLG-03 ; Shared Drive — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3_c_shared_test_plan

Thanks — looking forward to running the pilot.
